questions.question: When David cried out to God in a song for the choirmaster, what was his first request?

answers.text: That God hurry to help him
That God show him the way to go

questions.question: In a psalm about growing old, what did the writer's enemies say about him as they plotted against him?

answers.text: His friends have turned on him

questions.question: A psalm writer asks God not to forsake him even when he is old and gray, until he does what?

answers.text: Tells the next generation of God's power
Sees all of his enemies defeated
Returns to his old home again

questions.question: After speaking of the great things God has done, what question does the psalm writer ask God?

answers.text: How long will this go on
